title: DocumentRecord
description: Structured output returned by Claude for each captured page, appended to the open document's prompt-cached conversation. Property order is deliberate: structured outputs stream required properties in schema order, so doc_type arrives first and the UI can label the page before the rest of the JSON lands. Every property is required and nullable (optional properties count against the strict-schema complexity limit). No 'reasoning' field: asking for reasoning can trigger a reasoning_extraction refusal. All identifiers are last-4 placeholders; full secrets never leave the device (see 02-architecture.md, section 12).

continues_open_document.description: true if this page belongs to the document whose earlier pages are in this conversation; false if it starts a new document.

boundary_confidence.description: 0.0-1.0 confidence in continues_open_document. The device auto-merges or auto-splits only at >= 0.8.

suggested_merge_with.description: document id (from the context block) this page most likely belongs to when it is not the open document, else null.

expected_page_count.description: From 'Page N of M' or structure, else null.

language.description: BCP-47, e.g. en, es, fa, de.

due_date.description: Pay-by, respond-by, appear-by or renew-by date, whichever the document demands.

identifiers.description: Reference identifiers that users search by (Class B). Secrets (SSN, full account, routing, card, ID numbers) are never requested; the on-device Redactor already replaced them with last-4 placeholders in the input.

tags.description: 3-8 lowercase tags; prefer taxonomy tags from the system prompt.

title.description: Filename-safe, <= 80 chars, starts with the document date: '2025-03-14 ComEd electricity bill'.

summary.description: At most two sentences. No reasoning.

keep_original.description: true for vital records, wills, titles, notarized or bearer instruments, undeposited checks, identity documents.

sensitive.description: true for tax, medical, identity, insurance-claim and court classes (drives the high-sensitivity handling path).

corrections.description: Line-indexed corrections to the on-device OCR transcript, only where the image clearly contradicts the transcript. Used to patch the search index; never a full re-transcription.
